title: Pick-and-place spec v1
description: spec.json version 1 as it exists today. Grasshopper writes it (_part_record and process_print in Scripts/Py3-261103_1b2fe.py), and the Pipeline (Scripts/pipeline/traygen.py, layout_tray) adds or overwrites the write-back fields pick, slot, pocket, pocket_depth and slot_shape. All lengths are in mm. All coordinates are in Design_Space (the coordinates as stored in spec.json, Z up); pick and slot values use the tray frame that starts at tray_origin. Bed_Space (gcode) = Design_Space + bed offset, applied by the Pipeline, never stored here. Every object is closed (unknown keys are errors) except overrides, which hold free-form per-element settings.

version.description: Spec format version. Always 1 for this schema.

printer.description: Printer name from the Grasshopper 'printer' input, trimmed and lower-cased, for example 'snapmaker u1', 'prusa xl', 'mini'. Selects OrcaSlicer (U1) or PrusaSlicer and the printer config.

use_trace_braid.description: Grasshopper 'braid' input. true: traces are exported with type 'trace_braid'; false: 'trace_cloth'.

housing.description: File name of the housing mesh next to spec.json. Grasshopper writes 'housing.3mf'; 'housing.stl' is accepted as well.

tray.description: Tray source. Only 'generated' exists: the Pipeline builds tray.stl from the parts.

tray_spacing.description: Gap between tray slots and to the tray edge, in mm. Grasshopper writes 3.0.

tray_origin.description: Lower-left corner of the tray layout, in mm. Grasshopper writes (0, 0, 0).

parts.description: Elements to pick from the tray and place into the housing, in export order. Grasshopper does not write a spec without parts.

type.description: Part type. Selects the oneOf branch: 'trace_cloth' or 'trace_braid' (tracePart), 'plug' (plugPart), 'pcb' or 'print' (componentPart).

vec3.description: A point in mm, Z up.

z.description: Z in mm, Z up. May be negative.

rect.description: Axis-aligned rectangle in the XY plane of the tray frame, in mm. (x0, y0) is the lower-left corner, (x1, y1) the upper-right corner.

overrides.description: Free-form per-element settings from the C# Overrides dictionary (Dictionary<string, string>), exported through _jsonable. Keys that match a gcode config key override that key for this element; the Pipeline converts the value to the config key's type. This is the only open object in the schema. Grasshopper leaves the key out when the dictionary is empty.

tray_rotation.description: Rotation in degrees about Z, read by traygen when it cuts the component pocket into the tray. Strings must hold a number.

tamp.description: A tamping point on a trace (C# TampingPoint), in Design_Space mm, Z up. z has no minimum: type-3 tamp depth puts the nozzle below Z 0.

z.description: Z in mm, Design_Space, Z up. No minimum; negative values are valid.

type.description: C# TampingType as an integer: 0 End, 1 TraceTrace, 2 TracePlug, 3 TracePCB.

hole.description: A prinjection point on a component (C# PrinjectionPoint), in Design_Space mm, Z up.

z.description: Z in mm, Design_Space, Z up.

pick.description: Written by the Pipeline (traygen.layout_tray) on every run: where the nozzle picks the part up, in mm, tray frame, Z up. Grasshopper also exports a value (C# PickPt), which the Pipeline overwrites. No minimum on z. Optional; when it is missing, the assembler falls back to place.

slot.description: Written by the Pipeline (traygen.layout_tray): the part's opening in the tray, in mm, tray frame. Optional; Grasshopper does not export it.

pauseLayer.description: 1-based housing print layer after which the part is placed (the Pipeline pauses when its layer counter equals this value). Computed in C# as round(Z / layer height) + 1. Required: the C# PauseLayer is a non-nullable int, so _part_record always writes it, even though its 'if layer is not None' guard could in theory skip it. The assembler would never place a part without it.

place.description: Where the trace is put down, in mm, Design_Space, Z up.

pick.description: Written by the Pipeline (traygen.layout_tray): pick point inside the trace slot, in mm, tray frame; z is the trace height. Grasshopper also exports a value, which the Pipeline overwrites.

length.description: Trace length in mm along line_from to line_to.

horizontal.description: C# IsHorizontal. true: the trace lies in a horizontal tray column; false: vertical.

line_from.description: Start of the C# ModelLine, in mm, Design_Space. The nominal endpoint extended by width/2 + 0.15.

line_to.description: End of the C# ModelLine, in mm, Design_Space. The nominal endpoint extended by width/2 + 0.15.

tamps.description: Tamping points. Left out when there are none.

name.description: Optional display name. Written only when the Grasshopper object has a non-empty Name.

slot.description: Written by the Pipeline (traygen.layout_tray): the trace's tray opening, in mm, tray frame.

plugPart.description: A round plug or connector (C# Plug).

place.description: Where the plug is put down, in mm, Design_Space, Z up.

pick.description: Written by the Pipeline (traygen.layout_tray): centre of the round plug slot, in mm, tray frame; z is the plug height. Grasshopper also exports a value, which the Pipeline overwrites.

tamps.description: Tamping points. C# plugs have none today, but _part_record would write them, so they are allowed.

name.description: Optional display name. Written only when the Grasshopper object has a non-empty Name.

slot.description: Written by the Pipeline (traygen.layout_tray): square bounding box of the round plug opening (radius + 0.25 mm), in mm, tray frame.

slot_shape.description: Written by the Pipeline (traygen.layout_tray) for plugs: the opening inside slot is a circle.

componentPart.description: A PCB or a printed insert (C# PCB or Print). Its mesh is cut from the tray as a pocket.

type.description: 'print' for a C# Print, 'pcb' for any other C# PCB.

place.description: Where the component is put down, in mm, Design_Space, Z up.

pick.description: Written by the Pipeline (traygen.layout_tray): centre of the pocket, in mm, tray frame; z is size.z + 1. Grasshopper also exports a value, which the Pipeline overwrites.

size.description: Bounding box size of the component geometry in mm (x, y > 0). Grasshopper writes it only for a non-degenerate box; traygen needs it to cut the pocket.

bbox_center.description: Bounding box centre of the component geometry, in mm, Design_Space.

bbox_min.description: Bounding box minimum corner of the component geometry, in mm, Design_Space.

tray_offset.description: C# TrayOffset: clearance in mm between the component and its tray slot on each side. Only C# PCB and Print have TrayOffset, so only components carry it.

mesh.description: File name of the component mesh next to spec.json, 'part-<index in parts>.stl'. Written only for pcb and print parts.

tamps.description: Tamping points. Left out when there are none.

prinjection.description: Prinjection points (C# PrinjectionPoints). Left out when there are none.

name.description: Optional display name. Written only when the Grasshopper object has a non-empty Name.

slot.description: Written by the Pipeline (traygen.layout_tray): outer tray slot, size + 2 * tray_offset, in mm, tray frame.

pocket.description: Written by the Pipeline (traygen.layout_tray): inner pocket rectangle, slot shrunk by tray_offset, in mm, tray frame.

pocket_depth.description: Written by the Pipeline (traygen.layout_tray): pocket depth in mm, size.z - 0.5, at least 0.4.
